about: Research slices for welfare-lead runs. plan_research.py turns these into per-agent prompts with a web-search budget baked in. Weights split the budget; next_run_priorities come from the last run's coverage logs (arusha-welfare-2026-09) and should be searched first.

slices.name: arusha_city
slices.title: Arusha City Council area
slices.focus: Focus on residential care (children's homes, orphanages, baby homes, children's villages, street-children centres in the city) but record any welfare institution you find here, with its published business contacts and funder links.
queries: kituo cha kulelea watoto yatima Arusha
slices.stop_rule: 12 consecutive varied queries produce no new institution in the slice or every ward above has been searched
next_run_priorities: Ward-by-ward searches were not run in 2026-09: start with the wards above
Street-children centres in the city
Confirm the merged Huruma children's home record
Exact wards for homes recorded only as 'Arusha'

slices.title: Arusha District Council (Arumeru West), the ring around the city
slices.focus: Focus on residential care (children's homes, orphanages, children's villages, rescue homes) but record any welfare institution you find here, with its published business contacts and funder links.
queries: kituo cha kulelea watoto yatima Arumeru
slices.stop_rule: 12 consecutive varied queries produce no new institution in the slice or every ward above has been searched
next_run_priorities: 23 wards were not searched in 2026-09 (only about 10 were)

slices.name: family_programmes
slices.title: Family-based programmes across the whole catchment
slices.focus: Organisations that pay school fees or arrange schooling for children living with families: child and education sponsorship, orphans and vulnerable children programmes, kinship and foster-care support, family strengthening, church-based child development centres, primary bursary charities. Note which schools they use (as published).

SOS Children's Village Arusha family strengthening

sponsor a child Arusha Tanzania charity
orphans and vulnerable children programme Arusha NGO
watoto wanaoishi katika mazingira hatarishi Arusha NGO
slices.stop_rule: 12 consecutive varied queries produce no new organisation
next_run_priorities: No Kiswahili queries ran in 2026-09
Hai and Siha had no records; Moshi only four
Church and council orphan, foster and kinship programmes

slices.name: specialised_centres
slices.title: Specialised centres across the whole catchment
slices.focus: Centres for children with disabilities (physical, intellectual, deaf, blind, autism, albinism), rehabilitation centres, street-children centres, rescue or safe houses for girls, transition homes. Note whether each places children in mainstream day schools (as published).

kituo cha watoto wa mitaani Arusha
slices.stop_rule: 12 consecutive varied queries produce no new organisation

Mkombozi (site unreachable)

slices.name: funders_registers
slices.title: Funders, foreign charity registers and umbrella bodies
slices.focus: Foreign charities, faith and umbrella bodies and corporate funders that fund or operate welfare institutions in the catchment, from official registers (UK Charity Commission, OSCR, ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, ACNC, CBF/ANBI and others) and the charities' own sites. Record funders, relationships to the institutions they fund, and latest income with currency and year. Most of this slice is WebFetch on register pages, so it needs fewer searches.
seeds: KILI VIKINGS LIMITED -> Light in Africa
The Small Things -> Nkoaranga Village Organization
Little Souls of Tanzania -> Enyorata Children's Home
queries: charity Arusha children's home registered charity
slices.stop_rule: 12 consecutive varied register or web queries produce no new funder or supported institution
next_run_priorities: UK, Scottish, Australian, Canadian and Dutch registers blocked or empty in 2026-09; try their search pages again or the charities' own sites
Institutions known only from US tax filings need their own sites and routes

slices.name: parent_enquiries
slices.title: Public parent and guardian enquiries in the catchment
slices.focus: Publicly posted requests by adults seeking, for children they are responsible for, a school place, fee help or sponsorship, a children's-home place, foster or kinship support, or affordable English-medium school recommendations. Every record is pdpa_risk 'risky'. Record only what the post shows; no child identifiers; contact details only if published in that post; never look the person up elsewhere.
queries: shule nzuri ya English medium Arusha bei nafuu
slices.stop_rule: 12 consecutive varied queries produce no new relevant enquiry
next_run_priorities: No readable enquiries for Arusha city, Usa River, Tengeru, Boma Ng'ombe or Siha in 2026-09
JamiiForums blocks automated reading and Facebook groups need a login: record them as blocked, do not work around them
